blocks.heading: Choose Your Service Level and Room-Count Tier
paragraphs: Your service level depends on how much time your team has for daily pricing and channel work. We start with onboarding to set up the groundwork, then agree on a monthly programme.
rows: Managed pricing
We manage your pricing as a standalone service or as part of fully outsourced revenue management. If you choose pricing alone, your team keeps OTA and channel decisions.
Pricing and optimisation
We combine managed pricing with channel and segment optimisation.
Full revenue management
We handle daily pricing, OTAs and reporting. This broader service needs deeper system access and closer coordination with your team.
Setup and onboarding
We set up your competitor set, rate structure and baseline for the ongoing work. Your written proposal states the setup fee, which is a one-time, non-recurring charge.
Room-count tiers
Monthly hotel revenue management plans are priced in three tiers: 40 rooms or fewer, 41 to 120 rooms, and more than 120 rooms.

blocks.heading: How the Monthly Retainer Is Billed and What It Covers
paragraphs: Under our [payment terms](/terms-and-conditions/), prices are in USD excluding sales tax; Canadian clients add GST/HST. We invoice managed plans in advance on the 1st, due within 14 days.

items.heading: Payment methods and timing
items.text: You can pay by bank transfer or a major credit card. One-time services are paid in full at booking, and every proposal and contract shows our full legal name and registered business address.

items.heading: Monthly flexibility
items.text: You can stop any managed plan at the end of any month, and there's no long-term lock-in.

items.heading: Flat retainer
items.text: We don't charge a revenue commission, a percentage or a performance bonus, so your monthly fee stays the same in slow months.

items.heading: Included activity
items.text: Your plan has no cap on daily rate changes, reports or strategy calls.

items.heading: Separate project fees
items.text: Work outside your plan's scope, such as PriceLabs sessions or OTA listing optimisation, has a fixed one-time fee. We agree that fee with you in writing before the work starts.

items.heading: Additional team training
items.text: Extra remote team training is quoted separately, on top of your retainer.

items.heading: Third-party costs
items.text: Setup and retainer fees don't include OTA commissions, software subscriptions or ad and metasearch spend. You pay those providers directly.

blocks.heading: Bundle Several Services With Priority Turnaround
paragraphs: If you need several one-time services now, request them together. We'll bundle them, put them in the right order and give them priority turnaround. Coordinating work that depends on other work, such as pricing-tool setup and OTA listing optimisation, avoids rework and conflicting settings. Bundling only pays off when you need those services now. If you need a single urgent fix, order it on its own.

blocks.heading: Free, No-Commitment Consultation and Quote
paragraphs: Before you commit to anything, you get a free 30-minute consultation and a free quote, with no obligation. We talk through your property, channels and goals so the quote matches your actual scope and you don't run into surprises on scope or fees later. It's an overview conversation, not a full pricing and distribution audit.

blocks.heading: Steps From Your Request to a Signed Engagement

steps.heading: Book your consultation
steps.text: Once we've replied, we book your consultation within 3 business days of your request so we can talk through the engagement.

steps.heading: Receive your proposal
steps.text: Within 5 business days of the call, we send you a written proposal and quote that records everything we agreed. Having the scope in writing protects both of us.

steps.heading: Sign and provide access
steps.text: Onboarding starts once you sign and give us system access, and no pricing or channel work starts before that. Its opening audit sets your targets, not your fees.

items.question: What should I send if my property is new and has no recent performance figures?
items.answer: Send us your room count, room types, opening date, budget and any bookings you already have. If you have no booking history, we build your proposal from competitor-set rates and market demand data, and we price from those sources and your budget. As reservations come in, we switch to your own booking data. Pricing in the first months is less precise and needs closer review. Once a property has booking history, its pricing is more precise because it's based on its own data.

items.question: Can I ask for one proposal covering several properties?
items.answer: Yes. Just list each property's type, room count and location in a single request. We work with hotels, motels, B&Bs, serviced apartments and short-term rentals. Each property is priced in its own room-count tier, and we deliver the work in batches. You get one document that sets out the scope, fees and start order for each property.

items.question: Can I see a sample proposal before I send my details?
items.answer: Yes. Before you share your details, we can email you an anonymised sample proposal. If you ask, we also send an anonymised monthly performance report, full case studies for you to review before you sign.

items.question: Will you visit the property before you write the proposal?
items.answer: No. We work only remotely, inside your hotel's own systems and online accounts, and we don't have on-site staff at any property.
